schema_note: Enriched card merging the original retrodiction card + parameter audit + skeptic panel (4 reviewers, mean 2.88, no fatal objections) + repair-agent repairs and fertility scores. Repair status: repaired-with-narrowing. The core mathematics (NG_OBJECT_CONTRACTIVE + three lemmas) is a verified, fully-proven Class A recovery of classical Dobrushin/Seneta uniqueness; the repair strips the overclaimed diagnostic payload (spectral-gap/cycle/block rider, metastability-coexistence framing, executed-audit language) that the skeptic panel showed to be unjustified or unexecuted.

card.one_sentence_claim: Within the strict-Dobrushin-contraction regime, SBT's objecthood-as-fixed-points law (instantiated on the affine Markov packaging endomap E_{tau,f} or the macro kernel M_Pi, NEVER the bare micro kernel P) forces at most one nontrivial robust object, with the explicit eps-stable separation bound TV(nu,nu')<=2*eps/(1-lambda(E)); contrapositively, observed EXACT multiplicity of stable fixed points (separation surviving eps->0) certifies only that lambda(E)=1, i.e. failure of strict TV-contraction at that scale -- it does NOT by itself certify a closed spectral gap, reducibility, or cycle/block structure, and genuine finite-leak metastability sits INSIDE the contraction regime (lambda(E)<1) where the bound holds and the contrapositive does not fire.
card.target_known_fact: The standard Dobrushin/Markov ergodic theorem: a finite-state row-stochastic kernel P with Dobrushin contraction coefficient lambda(P)<1 has a unique stationary distribution pi and geometric convergence d_TV(mu P^t, pi) <= lambda(P)^t d_TV(mu,pi); equivalently, at a strictly contractive scale there is exactly one long-time invariant macro-object (Dobrushin 1956; Seneta 2006).
card.scientific_domain: Statistical mechanics / probability: finite Markov chains, relaxation, ergodicity, metastability and phase coexistence (and their SBT structural-law reorganization)
card.argument_family: uniqueness-necessity (a contrapositive necessity/no-go: strict contraction => unique object, hence exact multiplicity => non-contraction)
card.baseline_comparison: SBT RECOVERS the standard result; it does not beat it. The mathematical content (Dobrushin contraction => unique stationary distribution + geometric convergence, and an eps-stable separation bound TV<=2eps/(1-lambda)) is entirely classical and the No-Go paper cites it as such (Dobrushin 1956; Seneta 2006, No-Go line 344). SBT's contribution is REORGANIZATION, not new physics or new mathematics: it reframes the ergodic theorem as an 'objecthood necessity law' inside the emergence calculus and packages the contrapositive as a finite pass/fail audit vocabulary. Versus the standard metastability literature (almost-invariant sets, Perron-cluster/PCCA, spectral-gap analyses) it adds NO predictive power and NO sharper bound; crucially it does NOT reproduce the standard 'metastability = small spectral gap = near-decomposability' picture, because the proven inequality only fires at exact multiplicity (reducibility), whereas genuine finite-leak metastability has lambda(E)<1 with the bound satisfied. SBT constrains rather than predicts: it cannot say WHERE coexistence occurs, only that EXACT multiplicity of stable objects must live outside the strict-contraction regime.
card.why_scientists_care: It makes precise, inside one calculus, the limited but clean statement that 'a strictly contractive relaxation scale admits one stable macro-object', and supplies a quantitative finite separation bound TV<=2eps/(1-lambda(E)). For emergence theorists it cleanly separates 'stability' from 'multiplicity' (the constant-map / D-IC-02 guardrail) and shows that EXACT object multiplicity is a certificate of leaving strict contraction (reducibility / lambda(E)=1), not an SBT-object phenomenon. The honest payoff is conceptual hygiene, not a new metastability diagnostic: the result deliberately does NOT identify multiplicity with a small spectral gap, and flags that doing so would conflate reducibility with metastability.
target_audience: Statistical-mechanics / Markov-chain theorists working on metastability, almost-invariant sets, and spectral-gap relaxation
Emergence / complexity-science researchers interested in when coarse macro-objects are well-defined
Applied-probability and Perron-cluster (PCCA) practitioners who quantify metastable-set counts

card.honest_status_note: Grounded Class A recovery, low overfitting risk, presentational novelty only. The core mathematics is verified present and fully proven in the No-Go paper: NG_OBJECT_CONTRACTIVE (line 74, 427) plus lem:objecthood_dobrushin/_unique_fixed/_approximate_separation (proven app:probkl) give exactly TV(nu,nu')<=2eps/(1-lambda) and eps=0 uniqueness. E_{tau,f} is confirmed an affine Markov endomap (Foundations line 561, verbatim). The D-IC-02 nontriviality guardrail is carried verbatim (Foundations line 578). No SBT disclaimer is crossed (pure TV-contraction statement; no continuum, no empirical realization, no thermodynamic-entropy/Sigma_T, no Born rule, no pointer-basis). FOUR honest caveats confirmed against the sources and preserved after repair: (1) only eps=0 uniqueness is Lean-certified; the eps-stable bound and the contrapositive are paper-level only (No-Go lines 895-896, verbatim 'not part of the formalized core'). (2) The lambda used MUST be lambda(E_{tau,f}) (or lambda(M_Pi)) of the SAME operator whose fixed points are counted, NEVER lambda(P) of the micro kernel; conflation is a genuine smuggle, and the benchmark's metastability TV (To_Chart line 315) is measured on packaged basis states under the induced MACRO kernel M_Pi -- a third operator -- so the operator must be pinned. (3) The conclusion the theorem licenses is ONLY lambda(E)=1 (failure of strict TV-contraction; No-Go escape route line 434 'noncontractive regimes'); the 'closing spectral gap / cycle / block structure' rider in the original card is NOT implied (lambda=1 holds for many irreducible fast-mixing chains) and has been REMOVED. (4) The result fires only at EXACT multiplicity (reducibility); genuine finite-leak metastability has lambda(E)<1 with the bound satisfied (numerically confirmed by skeptic 2: leak=0.001, tau=1, lambda(E)=0.998<1, two eps~0.001-stable prototypes at separation 0.998, bound 2eps/(1-lambda)=1.0>=0.998), so the original 'metastable basins / phase coexistence NECESSARILY certify departure from contraction' headline was FALSE for real metastability and has been narrowed. The proposed lambda(E)-vs-coexistence numerical audit is NOT executed anywhere in the corpus (To_Chart computes lumpability/retention/idempotence/metastability defects but NO Dobrushin coefficient, NO eigenvalues, NO spectral gap -- verified by grep), and delta in the block family is a lumpability axis, not a contraction axis, so the original 'lambda->1 exactly where two basins separate on the block family' correspondence is unexecuted and likely mis-instantiated; data_points_matched is therefore 0 executed correspondences (one provable theorem). The spectral-gap stronger_result is dropped as unproven (E is non-reversible/non-self-adjoint; Dobrushin lambda<1 is sufficient-not-equivalent to a spectral gap).

opposite_world_test.explanation: SBT accommodates BOTH a single-object world (assign lambda(E)<1, strict contraction => unique fixed distribution) and a multi-object world (assign lambda(E)=1). The theorem is a one-way necessity, not a prediction: it never forbids either observation, only the forbidden CONJUNCTION 'demonstrably strictly contractive scale (lambda<1) AND >=2 well-separated robust objects with separation surviving eps->0', which a proven inequality genuinely forbids. This is the standard texture of a no-go/necessity law: real but weak, constraining rather than predicting. The lens/tau/U_f freedom means for almost any observed multiplicity one can find a scale where lambda=1 'explains' it and for any single object a scale where lambda<1 'explains' it, so the which-scale verdict is post-hoc selectable. Redeeming feature: the result imports a classical theorem and makes NO sign/direction claim that could be flipped to fit; there is no fitted quantity. The opposite-world flexibility lives entirely in which-scale selection, not in tunable physics.

audit.audit_verdict: GROUNDED RECOVERY (Class A), low overfitting risk, presentational novelty only. Core mathematics verified fully proven (No-Go lines 74, 427, 835-884, app:probkl). E_{tau,f} confirmed affine Markov endomap (Foundations 561); D-IC-02 guardrail carried verbatim (578). No SBT disclaimer crossed. You cannot tune parameters to fake a theorem, so high DOF does not create overfitting. The original card's headline (metastability/coexistence NECESSARILY certifies closing-gap/cycle/block) is partly false and was repaired: theorem yields only lambda(E)=1, and exact multiplicity = reducibility, not finite-leak metastability. The lambda(E)-vs-coexistence numerical audit is unexecuted; the block-family delta axis is lumpability not contraction. Retain as a Class A recovery with 'constrains-not-predicts', 'lambda(E) not lambda(P)', 'eps=0 reducibility not eps>0 metastability', and 'one named operator' framings preserved; do NOT upgrade to a predictive, spectral-gap, or metastability-diagnostic claim without (a) extending the Lean core and (b) running a real lambda-sweep on a genuinely metastable kernel.

reviewers.role: Mathematical physicist / probabilist (finite Markov chains, Dobrushin, metastability, Perron-cluster)
reviewers.main_objection: The headline conflates two distinct phenomena: the inequality forces lambda=1 only in the exact eps=0 limit, which is reducibility (block-diagonal chain, multiple stationary measures) -- a textbook triviality. Genuine metastability lives INSIDE the contraction regime: small positive spectral gap => lambda(E)<1, unique stationary law, yet two long-lived basins. Numerically verified: 4-state block chain, leak=0.001, tau=1, lambda(E_{tau,f})=0.998<1, two eps~0.001-stable prototypes at separation 0.998, bound 2eps/(1-lambda)=1.0>=0.998 satisfied -- contrapositive does NOT fire.
key_serious_objections: Near-tautology: 'separation survives eps->0 forces lambda=1' is an immediate restatement of the uniqueness lemma.
Zero new mathematics; only new item (contrapositive) is a logical restatement.
Stronger spectral-gap result uses a symmetrized operator (To_Create line 320), wrong object class for non-reversible E.
Confirmed lambda(E_{tau,f}) != lambda(P): leak=0.2, lambda(P)=0.6 constant in tau, lambda(E) drops 0.6->0.36->0.078->0 as tau grows.

reviewers.role: Finite-Markov / metastability theorist auditing relabeling and benchmark instantiation

The standard literature equates metastability with small spectral gap / near-reducibility, NOT with lumpability defect.
key_serious_objections: Benchmark direction inversion (delta = lumpability axis, not contraction axis).

Possible vacuity: with one-hot lifts the K prototypes are near-fixed by construction, so lambda(E_{tau,f})=1 trivially whenever the lens has >=2 blocks; non-vacuity of a strictly-contractive >=2-prototype instance not demonstrated.

reviewers.main_objection: The contrapositive OVERCLAIMS the mathematics: the theorem only licenses lambda(P)=1 (the paper's own escape route 'noncontractive regimes', line 434). lambda(P)=1 implies NONE of 'closed spectral gap, reducibility, cycle/block structure' -- lambda=1 holds for vast classes of irreducible fast-mixing chains (any two rows at TV distance 1). The headline diagnostic 'multiplicity => closing gap / block structure' is false as a deduction from the cited theorem; the only honest conclusion is the near-vacuous lambda=1.
key_serious_objections: Headline overclaim of the structural payload (spectral-gap/cycle/block rider unjustified).
Genuinely new step is trivial (one-line contrapositive; card says so).
Core numerical audit unexecuted (To_Chart tracks lumpability/mismatch/retention/idempotence only).
Which-operator equivocation beyond lambda(E) vs lambda(P): metastable basis states are eps-stable under the MACRO kernel M_Pi on Delta(X), a third operator.

allowed_repairs_applied: Narrowed the claim: restricted the contrapositive conclusion to 'lambda(E)=1 (failure of strict TV-contraction at that scale)' and REMOVED the unjustified 'closing spectral gap, cycle/block structure' rider (No-Go escape route line 434 only says 'noncontractive regimes'; lambda=1 does not imply a closed gap, reducibility, or block/cycle structure in general).

Replaced exact-with-approximate / split overbroad claim: split 'multiplicity' into (a) EXACT multiplicity surviving eps->0 = reducibility, where the contrapositive fires and forces lambda(E)=1, versus (b) finite-leak metastability at fixed eps>0, which has lambda(E)<1 with the bound 2eps/(1-lambda) satisfied and where the contrapositive does NOT fire. Removed the false 'genuine metastable basins / phase coexistence NECESSARILY certify departure from contraction' headline.

Clarified the mapping: pinned the corollary to ONE named operator (E_{tau,f} on Delta(Z) or the macro kernel M_Pi on Delta(X)) and require lambda reported for the SAME operator whose fixed points are counted; explicitly forbade substituting lambda(P) of the micro kernel.

Removed an assumption / corrected an instantiation: dropped the asserted 'lambda->1 exactly where two basins separate on the block family' correspondence as unexecuted and mis-mapped (delta is a lumpability axis, not a contraction axis; To_Chart computes no Dobrushin coefficient). Reframed the block family as a candidate testbed, not a numerical instantiation; set data_points_matched_executed=0.

Turned rhetoric into a lemma sequence: stated the content as the proven chain lem:objecthood_dobrushin -> lem:objecthood_unique_fixed -> lem:objecthood_approximate_separation -> (eps=0 collapse) -> contrapositive, carrying the D-IC-02 nontriviality clause verbatim.

Dropped the unproven stronger_result: removed the two-sided spectral-gap / Perron-cluster 'k objects => quantitative gap deficit' diagnostic (E non-reversible/non-self-adjoint; Dobrushin lambda<1 sufficient-not-equivalent to a spectral gap), or marked it explicitly as unproven.
repair.forbidden_repairs_avoided: No arbitrary assumptions added; no hidden tuning; imported classical physics (Dobrushin/Seneta) kept explicit; uniqueness is the proven eps=0 consequence (not asserted); no undefined 'naturally emerges' language. The narrowing only weakens the claim toward what the in-paper lemmas actually license.
repair.what_survives: The minimum-viable corollary survives fully proven from the in-paper lemmas: 'within the strict-Dobrushin-contraction regime (lambda(E)<1) SBT admits at most one nontrivial robust object (with the D-IC-02 nontriviality clause), with explicit eps-stable separation TV(nu,nu')<=2eps/(1-lambda(E))', and its contrapositive 'EXACT multiplicity of stable objects (separation surviving eps->0) certifies lambda(E)=1, i.e. failure of strict TV-contraction'. This is an honest, exactly-evaluable structural recovery requiring no new mathematics. The metastability-diagnostic, spectral-gap, and executed-audit framings do not survive.
remaining_objections_unrepaired: Pure recovery: zero new mathematics; the only new item (contrapositive) is a one-line logical restatement of an already-proven inequality. Novelty is presentational. (Not repairable -- it is the honest status.)

Weak one-directional necessity: the result constrains (forbids the contractive+exact-multiplicity conjunction) but does not predict; which-scale verdict is post-hoc selectable via the non-canonical lens/tau/U_f freedom.

Near-vacuity of the surviving contrapositive: lambda(E)=1 is a weak conclusion (holds for many ergodic chains), and on a fixed finite chain 'separation survives eps->0' reduces to the uniqueness lemma.

Non-vacuity of the dichotomy on E_{tau,f} not yet demonstrated: with one-hot lifts and >=2 blocks, lambda(E_{tau,f})=1 may be generic, so a strictly-contractive >=2-candidate-prototype instance exercising the unique-vs-multiple dichotomy must still be exhibited.

Only eps=0 uniqueness is Lean-certified; the eps-stable bound and contrapositive remain paper-level (No-Go lines 895-896). Repairable by extending the Lean core (low-risk, three-line triangle-inequality proof).
No executed lambda(E)-vs-coexistence audit on a genuinely metastable kernel exists; the diagnostic remains a proposal, not a demonstration.

triage.bin_rationale: B = foundational sanity check. This is a grounded Class A recovery of a textbook theorem, reorganized as an SBT objecthood-necessity corollary. Its proper role is a consistency/sanity anchor in the no-go obstruction layer (does the calculus correctly recover Dobrushin uniqueness as an objecthood law, with the D-IC-02 guardrail honored?), not a flagship (C), not a high-risk numerical bet (D), and not pure reframing-only (E) since real proven machinery is instantiated. It is close to an A (immediate quick win) because the corollary is days of work, but the honest narrowing strips most of its advertised payoff, so its value is sanity-check / hygiene rather than a standalone win.
triage.recommended_priority: Low-to-medium. Worth writing as a 1-3 pp corollary note for completeness of the no-go layer and to lock in the reducibility-vs-metastability and lambda(E)-not-lambda(P) hygiene, but not a priority over results with genuine discriminative power. If pursued, the highest-value add is (a) extending the Lean core to the eps-stable bound, and (b) a small honest numerical exhibit on a genuinely metastable slow-leak kernel showing lambda(E)<1 with the bound satisfied -- which would demonstrate the corrected (constrains-not-predicts) statement rather than the original overclaim.
triage.one_line_verdict: A correct, fully-proven Class A recovery of Dobrushin uniqueness repackaged as an SBT objecthood-necessity corollary; valuable as a foundational sanity check but presentational-only, weak, and stripped of its overclaimed metastability/spectral-gap diagnostic after narrowing.
